description: Full-width hero section with headline, optional subtitle, optional CTA buttons (primary + secondary), and optional image. Supports four layout variants.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

eyebrow.description: Optional short kicker/label rendered as a pill above the title (e.g. "NEW", "PLUGIN OFICIAL").

subtitle.description: Supporting subheadline shown below the title.

cta_text.description: Primary CTA button label. Leave empty to hide both buttons.

cta2_text.description: Secondary CTA button label. Renders as outline/ghost style. Only shown when cta_text is also set.

cta_variant.description: Primary CTA button style. 'primary' = filled accent (bare .btn). 'secondary' = muted surface fill. 'outline' = accent border, transparent fill. 'ghost' = borderless text button. Set via update_component (a prop, not a style slot).

cta2_variant.description: Secondary CTA button style — defaults to 'outline' to match the historical always-outline second button. 'primary' = filled accent. 'secondary' = muted surface fill. 'ghost' = borderless text button. Set via update_component (a prop, not a style slot).

variant.description: Layout variant. 'centered' centers all content. 'left' aligns content left. 'split' places text left and image right at lg+. 'cover' uses image_url as a full-width background image with dark overlay and white text.

image_url.description: Image URL. Rendered as an inline image in 'split' variant, or as a CSS background-image in 'cover' variant.

image_alt.description: Alt text for the split variant image. Use a descriptive string for meaningful images; leave empty only if image is purely decorative.

spacing.description: Vertical padding override. 'compact' tightens padding. 'spacious' adds extra breathing room. 'default' uses the component's built-in padding (subject to CSS rhythm defaults).

width.description: Content width override. 'narrow' constrains to 56rem. 'full' stretches to viewport (with padding). 'default' uses the standard max-width.

split_ratio.description: Grid column ratio for the split variant. '60-40' gives more space to text, '40-60' gives more to the image. Ignored on non-split variants.

vertical_align.description: Vertical alignment of content within the hero. Applies to cover and split variants only. Ignored on centered/left variants. Ignored below 1024px.

proof.description: HTML string for trust signals (client logos, star ratings, user counts). Rendered after the CTA group inside hero__content. Sanitized via wp_kses_post. When empty, no DOM element is rendered.

--hero-padding-top.description: Top padding of the hero section

--hero-padding-bottom.description: Bottom padding of the hero section

--hero-bg.description: Background color or gradient. Note: also used as the outline button's hover text color, which is invalid CSS if set to a gradient — that hover color falls back to inherited text color when this is a gradient (a narrow, isolated cosmetic limitation, not a broken page).

--hero-cta2-bg.description: Second CTA button background color, independent of the primary button. Applies whatever cta2_variant is set to.

--hero-cta2-border.description: Second CTA button border color, independent of the primary button.

--hero-cta2-color.description: Second CTA button text color, independent of the primary button.

--hero-cta2-hover-bg.description: Second CTA button hover background color.

--hero-cta2-hover-border.description: Second CTA button hover border color.

--hero-cta2-hover-color.description: Second CTA button hover text color.

--hero-content-width.description: Max width of the content column

--hero-overlay-bg.description: Cover variant overlay background color or gradient (e.g. a transparent-to-dark scrim for text legibility over an image)

--hero-border-color.description: Border color of the hero section

--hero-border-width.description: Border width of the hero section

--hero-radius.description: Border radius of the hero section

--hero-shadow.description: Box shadow of the hero section (preset var(--shadow-sm|md|lg) or a bounded box-shadow)

--hero-surface-bg.description: Background of the inner proof/artifact surface panel — a solid color or a gradient (the default is itself a gradient; set either to override it)

--hero-surface-padding.description: Padding inside the inner hero surface panel

--hero-surface-border-color.description: Border color of the inner hero surface panel

--hero-surface-border-width.description: Border width of the inner hero surface panel

--hero-surface-radius.description: Border radius of the inner hero surface panel

--hero-surface-shadow.description: Box shadow of the inner hero surface panel (preset var(--shadow-sm|md|lg) or a bounded box-shadow)

dark-spacious.description: Dark background with generous padding and light text

bold-headline.description: Oversized title with narrow content column
